assumptions: Weights, gamma, token table and main multiplication inputs are checked at abs<=256 in f12
Probability abs<=1 at f24; retrieval components abs<=2 at f20
NR states checked in [0,2]; scaled RMS components checked at abs<=96
Every rescale occurs after complete sum as specified; no unchecked modular wrap
Private failure values use prescribed safe replacement and are never released as a normal answer
scope: Analytic operator-domain conditional no-wrap bounds; does not prove all model activations remain in domain
RMS_scaled_component_derivation: For d<=2048, |X|/sqrt(A)<=sqrt(d). Quantized k gives sqrt(A)/2^k<2, so |B|/2^24<=2sqrt(2048)<91<96.
L2_scaled_component_derivation: For positive sum of squares S and chosen k, |X|<=sqrt(S)<2^(k+1), so scaled component |B|/2^24<=2. Invalid branch uses zero vector and positive dummy denominator.
secret_shift_requirement: Use exponent ranges and pre-shift bit bounds; invalid exponent must select both k=0 and a=1 before normalization
known_limitations: This artifact is not a BFV noise bound or a session failure-probability proof.
Integer range checks are required during every R1/R2 model invocation.
Finite public constant agreement at two precisions is not a formal interval arithmetic certificate.
